title: Fiscal Policy Calculator
description:
Ten-year budget estimates for U.S. tax and spending proposals, each shown beside the published score (CBO, JCT, Treasury and others) it is checked against, with out-of-sample error reported by policy class.

Each release archives the Python scoring engine, the static export the website at https://fiscal.lwilsesamson.com reads, and the frozen snapshots of every set of scored figures the site has published (site_data/snapshots/). The release notes name the newest snapshot and its sha256.
